cultural_notes: Spokane sits on the Spokane River with the falls running through downtown Riverfront Park, in a basalt-gorge-and-ponderosa-pine landscape (source: en.wikipedia.org Spokane, Washington)

the Palouse to the south is a distinctive rolling wheat, lentil, and legume country; Green Bluff (northeast of the city) is a well-known u-pick apple and cherry orchard district (source: Palouse + Green Bluff agriculture framing, publicly documented)
Spokane has a notable Russian and Ukrainian community from Slavic immigration to the Inland Northwest (source: general demographic framing, publicly documented)

Fred Meyer, Yoke's, Rosauers (a Spokane-founded grocer), and WinCo are the regional grocers; huckleberries are a prized wild Inland Northwest berry (source: chain regional footprint; huckleberry regional framing)
